info.name: Project Payroll API
info.description: Project payroll workflow for the assigned project admin only. Every payroll route resolves the project from the bearer token, so no project ID is sent in a payroll URL. Payroll must be enabled before salaries, periods, lines, adjustments, or sync can be managed. Pending payroll can be edited; paid payroll is locked. Net pay is gross salary + additions - manual deductions - attendance deductions.

item.name: My Project Payroll
item.description: Routes for the assigned PROJECT_ADMIN. The project is resolved from the authenticated token; no project ID is sent in the URL.

request.description: Returns whether payroll is enabled for the authenticated project. This endpoint remains available when payroll is disabled. Requires PAYROLL_READ.

Enables or disables payroll for the token project. Enabling creates or recalculates the current pending period from day 1 through today, including employees with active salaries and attendance violations. The first enable also seeds the default 10 attendance-violation rules. Requires PAYROLL_MANAGE.
Returns the token project's attendance-violation rules. Requires PAYROLL_READ.
Replaces the token project's attendance-violation policy. Provide the complete validated rules array. Requires PAYROLL_MANAGE.

formdata.description: Optional when the workbook contains Sheet5.
Optional YYYY-MM-DD salary effective date. The import ensures a pending payroll period exists for this month; existing paid periods remain unchanged.

request.description: Bulk creates or updates salary history for existing employees in the token project. User matches username; unmatched users are rejected and no users are created. Validation is all-or-nothing. For a current or past effective month, the period is synchronized immediately so employees with a salary above zero are added to payroll lines.

Synchronizes attendance violations for the selected month. Manual lines and adjustments are preserved and totals are recalculated. Paid periods are locked. The automatic job runs every day at 6:00 AM Asia/Riyadh.
Creates an empty pending monthly period or returns the existing pending period. Save the returned period.id as periodId.

Adds an existing employee from the token project to a pending period, even without attendance. The gross salary also creates or updates that employee's effective salary history. Duplicate employee lines are rejected. Save the returned line.id as lineId.
Updates gross salary and/or note while pending. Gross salary updates the employee salary effective from the period start, then net pay is recalculated.
Adds one positive monthly payroll item. Amount must be greater than zero and reason is required. Any number of additions can be added while pending. Save adjustment.id as adjustmentId.
Adds one manual deduction. It remains separate from calculated attendance deductions. Amount must be greater than zero and reason is required.
Updates any supplied fields on a pending adjustment and recalculates the line. An empty body is rejected.
Deletes an adjustment from a pending payroll and recalculates the employee net pay. Paid history cannot be changed.

Returns { items, total }. All filters are optional: month (YYYY-MM), status (pending|paid), search (employee name or username), employeeId, hasAdditions, hasDeductions (manual deductions), hasViolations (attendance deductions), grossMin, grossMax, netMin, and netMax. Remove query parameters you do not want to filter by.
Returns one period from the authenticated admin's project with payroll lines, employee details, attendance violations, and manual additions and deductions. Requires PAYROLL_READ.
Marks the full pending period paid. After this, sync, salary changes, line updates, additions, deductions, edits, and deletion are rejected.
Downloads the XLSX salary import template with No, Name, User, and Salary columns.
